indicator_name: Hours actually worked by employees, annual
description: Фактически отработанное время работниками, годовое (региональный сегмент Taldau)
methodology: Million man-hours actually worked by employees in the year (enterprise survey, Taldau 703017, regional segment), national, 2000-2012 and 2017 onward. 2013-2016 exist only on a segment with about 8 % lower coverage and are deliberately not spliced in; use HOURS_WORKED_QUARTERLY from 2016.
